card.name: Your/our before pet words
card.fires_on: Small linking words, mostly 'your', 'our', 'for', 'of', right before an expected pet-related noun such as dog, pet, tank or animals. Seen in pet care and veterinary web text.

modes.label: Possessive before pet
modes.description: 'your' or 'our' just before the word dog, pet or tank in pet-care writing.
modes.example: Certain dog toys contain chemicals that studies suggest could lead to health problems in<< your>> dog, according to a presentation this week

modes.label: Other linking word in pet text
modes.description: 'for', 'and', 'of' or an opening bracket where a pet or animal term is expected next.
modes.example: ALL ABOUT DOGS and CATS Resource Center<< for>> Canine & Feline Lovers

card.writes: Little clear effect; it promotes letter-p fragments like 'ps' and 'par' and suppresses 'machine' words.
card.plain: It lights up on small words like 'your' that come right before a pet word in pet-care text.
